usage.useWhen: One honest rating of a product, book, course or service, alone or as a short review with author.
usage.avoidWhen: Average ratings without a real data source, and reviews of your own business: Google shows no review stars for LocalBusiness or Organization reviews on its own site.
usage.a11y: The stars are hidden from assistive technology; the value is visible text, for example 4.5 out of 5 stars. Filled and outlined stars share one color, so the rating never depends on color.
